Cityhood (CITY)
Website: https://cityhood.fun
X: https://x.com/appcityhood (@appcityhood)
Tagline: Every block has an owner

Summary
Cityhood is an NFT collection of 4,333 city blocks on Robinhood Chain (chain ID 4663, gas token ETH). Each NFT is an isometric diorama of one city block: matte black buildings with lime-lit windows on pure black. Artwork tiers: Block (common), District (rare), Landmark (legendary).

Mint model
Minting happens only on OpenSea, through the SeaDrop drop protocol. This website is for information, registration, and winner status checking only. It never sells NFTs, takes payment, or asks for wallet signatures.

Stages (total supply 4,333)
- GTD: 500 spots, free, max 1 per wallet, guaranteed allocation for raffle winners.
- WL: 1,000 spots, $0.50 (paid in ETH equivalent at mint), max 2 per wallet, raffle winners.
- Public: 2,833 supply, $1.50 (paid in ETH equivalent at mint), max 3 per wallet, open to everyone, no registration.
Unminted GTD and WL supply rolls into Public.

Registration
Registration for GTD and WL takes place at https://cityhood.fun/register
Requirements: follow the project X account (@appcityhood, https://x.com/appcityhood) and repost the announcement post, then submit an EVM wallet address and X username.
Winners are chosen by raffle from valid registrations after registration closes. One registration per wallet per stage.
Winner lists are published at https://cityhood.fun/data/status.json and can be checked on the Register page.

Royalty
5% creator royalty (ERC-2981).

Utility token ($CITY)
$CITY is the utility token of Cityhood on Robinhood Chain. Every block claims $CITY once, at a rate set by its tier: Block 250,000, District 500,000, Landmark 2,500,000. A claim belongs to the block: if an unclaimed block is sold, the claim travels with it. Fixed supply 10,000,000,000. Allocation: block claims 20% (2,000,000,000, covering the full 1,853,000,000 claim pool), liquidity 10%, city treasury 60%, team 10%. Unclaimed $CITY is burned when the claim window closes. The $CITY contract is in preparation and has not been deployed yet; the claim opens after the mint.

Contracts
Cityhood NFT (SeaDrop): 0x306073f5338Ca906de252A9Bf055ad72733820C3
$CITY token: not yet deployed; the address will be announced on this site.
Chain explorer: https://robinhoodchain.blockscout.com

Status
Registration is closed and the raffle is drawn: no valid entries were received, so no GTD or WL winners were drawn and the full 4,333 supply opens in the Public stage. Drop configuration is in progress; the mint date is announced on X (@appcityhood) and on this site first. Any date or mint link not published on cityhood.fun or the official project X account is unofficial.
